content: pandoc lang metadata (BCP-47, e.g. pt-BR) drives babel/polyglossia in LaTeX (hyphenation patterns, localized dates, localized quotes with the smart extension) and the lang attribute in HTML/EPUB output. WeasyPrint supports hyphens/hyphenate-character/hyphenate-limit-chars/hyphenate-limit-zone; automatic hyphenation requires a lang attribute matching a Pyphen dictionary; Pyphen ships pt_BR and pt_PT dictionaries with underscore locale codes; CSS generated-content quotes are NOT implemented in WeasyPrint.
